newsitem.title: USA: Abaxis says wins plant approval from FDA.
newsitem.headline: Abaxis says wins plant approval from FDA.

text.p: ABAXIS Inc said on Monday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has deemed its manufacturing plant "in-compliance" with regulations.
The move clears the company's medical device products for sale to other federal agencies and allows it to apply for an export certificate.

"Working closely with the FDA, we are very pleased to have resolved the issues concerning validation of our manufacturing equipment and processes," Clint Severson, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
